comment: Every item in the game. value is the shop price in coins; shops buy back at 40%. Items don't stack unless stackable is true. tool.bonus is added to the chance of success per attempt. heals is used from phase 4.

items.name: Coins
items.examine: Kelmoor crowns. Lovely money.

items.name: Bronze axe
items.examine: A sturdy axe with a bronze head. Good for felling trees.

items.name: Iron axe
items.examine: An iron-headed axe. It bites deeper than bronze.

items.name: Steel axe
items.examine: A well-balanced steel axe.

items.name: Bronze pickaxe
items.examine: Used for mining. The point is a little blunt.

items.name: Iron pickaxe
items.examine: An iron pickaxe. Rocks don't stand a chance.

items.name: Steel pickaxe
items.examine: A heavy steel pickaxe.

items.name: Small fishing net
items.examine: Good for scooping up little fish in the shallows.

items.name: Fishing rod
items.examine: A rod for deep-water fishing. It needs bait.

items.name: Fishing bait
items.examine: Wriggly worms in a pot. Fish love them.

items.name: Hammer
items.examine: A smith's hammer, for working metal on an anvil.

items.name: Logs
items.examine: Freshly cut logs, still smelling of sap.

items.name: Ashwood logs
items.examine: Pale, bone-dry logs from a tree the Ashen Waste killed. They burn hot.

items.name: Oak logs
items.examine: Heavy oak. Worth more than ordinary logs.

items.name: Willow logs
items.examine: Springy willow from the riverbank.

items.name: Yew logs
items.examine: Dark, close-grained yew from Elderglen.

items.name: Starwood logs
items.examine: Pale wood with a faint light in the grain.

items.name: Copper ore

items.name: Tin ore

items.name: Iron ore
items.examine: Heavy, rust-coloured ore.

items.name: Coal

items.name: Gold ore
items.examine: Heavy ore, bright where it catches the light.

items.name: Cobalt ore
items.examine: Deep blue ore. Nobody in the Reaches can work it yet.

items.name: Verdite ore
items.examine: Green-black ore, harder than steel.

items.name: Glacite ore
items.examine: Pale blue ore, cold to hold.

items.name: Bronze bar

items.examine: A bar of iron, ready for the anvil.

items.name: Steel bar

items.name: Gold bar
items.examine: A bar of soft, bright gold.

items.examine: A plain bronze sword.

items.examine: A solid iron sword.
